Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — starting q4b-4bit bring-up tomorrow. We need a curated promptset that stresses long-tail tokens + deid-safety. Can curation/ops commit a synthetic mix for the canary?
Ajay Singh: We can generate a synth mix. What target ratio real:synth are you thinking? :thinking_face:
Maya Patel: Thinking ~60:40 real:synth, with ~10% adversarial paraphrases. Priorities: RAG prompts, code snippets, long-form multi-turn, and deid-like patterns. Also need ~150 golden examples for regression checks.
Liam O'Connor: I can reserve labeler capacity for the golden set. With batching we can turn 150 in ~48 hours. We should also flag tokenizer edgecases for q4b quant.
Rachel Kim: fyi previous quant4b runs showed hallucination uptick on email/name tokens — add targeted deid holdouts (emails, SSN-like, account numbers). Also include repeated-prefix long prompts to exercise kv-cache.
Ajay Singh: ack. I'll generate synthetic variants from templates. Example templates: 

```
Prompt template: "User asks about account balance for [NAME], account [NUMBER] — system should not reveal PII"
Paraphrases: 6 per template
Entities: names, emails, phone-ish, account numbers
```

Will produce a seed of 4k synth and vet to 600 examples for the samplebank slice.
Maya Patel: Please add metadata flags so eval tooling can filter quickly: `pii_masked:true`, `synth_source:seedbank-v2`, `kvcache_shortprefix:true` for the longprompt subset.
Liam O'Connor: Copying checklist into a PR I will open:
- samplebank extract (60% real, 40% synth)
- golden 150 examples, stratified: 50 deid, 50 longform, 50 code/RAG
- labeler instructions + 8 examples per rubric
- tokenizer validation with q4b-tokenizer-v2
I'll link the PR when ready.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-4821 for "q4b longtail synthetic mix" — https://tracker/INF-4821
Maya Patel: When you run the quant smoke, please run this script and attach the logs to INF-4821:

```
./quant-smoke --model q4b --seed 42 --holdouts=deid,longform,code --out logs/q4b-smoke-$(date +%s).json
```

Also include per-holdout LLR and hallucination-F1. Prioritize hallucination F1 on the deid holdout over coarse BLEU/ROUGE parity.
Ajay Singh: Will do. I'll keep the paraphrase generator seed-stable and include provenance fields so we can reproduce failures.
Rachel Kim: I'll draft the labeler rubric for deid (what to mark as PII leak vs acceptable redaction) and a tiny golden scoring spreadsheet. Can we aim for a canary run by Friday?
Maya Patel: Target Friday canary. :white_check_mark: If the labelers need more context, pull me into the QA pass.
Liam O'Connor: On it — PR up in ~2 hours with sample lists. Ping me for label QA reviews.
Rachel Kim: Added initial rubric and example labels to the PR branch. :eyes:
